mechanism: Efavirenz induces CYP450 enzymes which may increase propylthiouracil metabolism, potentially reducing antithyroid efficacy; propylthiouracil carries hepatotoxicity risk that may be compounded by efavirenz hepatic effects.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) more frequently and adjust propylthiouracil dosing as needed; monitor liver function tests and counsel on hepatotoxicity symptoms.
